name: command-bar
title: CommandBar
description: Spotlight for your app: natural language becomes one of your registered actions or routes, chosen by on-device tool calling, with preview and confirmation.

files.content:
export const commandInstructions = (hasTools: boolean) =>
  hasTools
    ? 'You are the command bar of this app. Pick exactly one of the available tools that best matches the request and call it with precise parameters. Do not explain. If nothing matches, reply with the single word NONE.'
    : 'You are the command bar of this app. Choose the single best action id for the request and return JSON only.'

export const previewInstructions = 'Describe in at most 8 words what will happen.'

export { CommandBar, commandBarLabels, type CommandBarProps, type CommandBarIcons, type CommandBarLabels, type CommandBarStyles, type CommandRowProps } from './command-bar'
export { useCommandBar, rankActions, type CommandBarState, type CommandResult, type UseCommandBarOptions } from './use-command-bar'
export { defineAction, defineActions, routesToActions, type CommandAction } from './actions'

docs: Register actions with defineActions(); risky actions (risk: 'high') ask before running.

budget.strategy: Top 5 tools preselected by keyword relevance; the query is truncated to the budget.

limits: On Gemini Nano it picks the action from structured output instead of tool calls.
